title: Trap-Free Utility Toolkit
instructions: Implement the seven trap-free utilities in `toolkit.py`: `append_unique`, `make_adders`, `chunked`, `dedupe`, `top_k_tokens`, `moving_average` and `close_enough`. Each is the correct version of a classic Python interview trap (shared mutable default, late-binding closure, eager materialisation, quadratic membership, float equality). Standard library only; state the complexity in your docstrings.

evidence.label: append_unique creates a fresh list per call and honours an explicit bucket without duplicates
make_adders gives each adder its own offset
chunked splits iterables into lists of at most size items
chunked is lazy and works on an infinite iterator
chunked raises ValueError("size must be >= 1") for size below 1
dedupe keeps first-seen order for any iterable
top_k_tokens ranks by count with alphabetical tie-breaks
top_k_tokens handles empty text, k = 0, apostrophes and rejects negative k
moving_average returns full-window averages only and rejects window < 1
close_enough uses isclose with relative and absolute tolerances
